io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.core.services.localization

Class MenuTranslationService

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.core.services.localization.MenuTranslationService

  • public class MenuTranslationService
extends java.lang.Object
    Translates the decorative info items inside a block's BlockMenu (titles, descriptions and background labels) per language. These strings are hardcoded English literals in each machine's preset; this service keeps a per-language override keyed by preset id (= item id) and slot, loaded from languages/<lang>/menus.yml shipped by core and addons. Block menu inventories are shared per placed block, so the translation is applied for the viewing player when they open the menu. Only the preset's decorative slots are rewritten - input/output slots (the only slots persisted to disk) are never touched, so stored inventories are unaffected.

      • applyToMenu

        public void applyToMenu(@Nonnull
                        BlockMenu menu,
                        @Nonnull
                        org.bukkit.entity.Player p)
        Rewrites the decorative info items of an opened BlockMenu into the viewing player's language. Falls back to the English (en) entry so a player whose language lacks an entry (or an English player after a German player opened the same block) sees the correct language. Slots with no translation in either the player's language or English are left untouched.

      • describeHeaderResolution

        @Nonnull
public static java.lang.String describeHeaderResolution(@Nonnull
                                                                 BlockMenuPreset preset)
        Reports how resolveTitleColor(me.mrCookieSlime.Slimefun.api.inventory.BlockMenuPreset) would colour preset's title today: the header slot the name-matching heuristic resolves, or every named decorative slot it could have matched. Feeds the boot-time menu audit while presets are migrated off the heuristic onto an explicit declaration.
        Parameters:
        preset - The preset to describe
        Returns:
        A one-line description of the current resolution

      • dumpBaseline

        public void dumpBaseline(@Nonnull
                         java.io.File out)
        Development helper: writes the English baseline of every currently-registered block-menu preset to the given file as menus.yml, capturing each decorative slot's name and lore. Pure background panes (blank name, no lore) are skipped. This covers core and all loaded addons in one pass, giving an exact preset-id/slot baseline to translate. Call once after all items are loaded.

      • getKeyCoverage

        @Nonnull
public int[] getKeyCoverage(@Nonnull
                                     java.lang.String languageId)
        Key coverage of a language: {covered, total} where total is the number of English (presetId, slot) menu entries and covered is how many of those the given language also defines (an entry only ever exists non-empty - see load(java.lang.String, java.io.InputStream)). English returns {total, total}.
